Name: Novan's Seasonal Grass Path (FIXED 1.6)
Author: cathtail
Description:
This is just an update for Novan's Seasonal Grass Path. This should fix Brick, Rustic Plank and Stone Walkway floors. 
All credits go to Novan, all I did was to (hopefully) fix the new floors that came with 1.4 and 1.5 so they wouldn't be transparent anymore.

[size=5]
Install
[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Recommended:[/size]
[list]
[*]Gravel Sound Replacer! I made a mod to replace the gravel path sound with grass steps. You can find it under optional files!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14767]Sound Tweaker[/url]﻿ needed.
[/list]
